title: Understanding the Pattern
text: The pattern is used to extract specific parts of the string. In this case, we want to extract the servings and the course type.

title: Identifying the Servings
text: The servings are enclosed in square brackets, e.g., [24]. We need a pattern that can match any number inside these brackets.

title: Identifying the Course Type
text: The course type is represented by a single letter (M, S, A, D) following the word 'Course:'. We need a pattern that can match any of these letters.

title: Pattern for Servings
text: What pattern can we use to match any number inside square brackets?

title: Pattern for Course Type
text: What pattern can we use to match a single letter representing the course type?
